# Assumption of Moses Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Conquest and Early History Foretold

---

**1** The Most High God and the Eternal One who is before all things and sits upon the throne of his kingdom, speaking through me as a prophet to you, will come to you and will act as he promised to the fathers, to Israel.

**2** He will enter the holy land and deal with it according to his decree, distributing it and giving it to your tribes.

**3** You will be able to enter and settle in it, while I and all the princes of the tribes will be gathered to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob our fathers.

**4** Then your kingdom will prosper, and you will dwell in it for many days.

**5** And after you there will arise among them a ruler who will plough the whole earth and judge it.

**6** Then in a short time they will be scattered among the nations and will remain under the power of the nations for many years.

**7** But the Most High, who looks upon all things, will behold their affliction and will deliver them through Moses, the great mediator.

**8** And the tribes will be in the holy land, and you will go your way and complete your days.

**9** Remember, Joshua, that it was not on account of any virtue or strength on the part of this people that you have been appointed to lead them in to the possession of their inheritance.

**10** Rather it is because our fathers were faithful, and in his mercy God made his covenant with them, swearing to increase their offspring.

**11** And he has fulfilled and confirmed this truly.

**12** Enter the land which he has promised to give to them; give it to them as their inheritance and lead them according to what he has prescribed for them.
